notes.title: MareQuest: An Interactive Tail Updates
notes.content:
[h3]Hello fellow mare enthusiasts! There's been pretty good progress with MareQuest: An Interactive Tail over the past few months. Still no exact release date, but rest assured we're working hard to make it a fun and unique experience, not only for the mare gaming industry but the gaming industry in general. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118609/c56bdbfefc43bfcee4ff50d7ba03503d8fccbd64.png[/img]

[h3]Being completely modest, we have GOTY 2023 on lockdown. There's no competition whatsoever. I have seen the future and it is mare. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118609/131b95b8200ddec9c710b63399a3a30f3c7796a2.png[/img]

[h3]I'm hesitant to give all of our trade secrets, but I will say some neat features of the new game include a cute and (hopefully) well written story, important friendship choices, inventory and friendship management, adorable random interactions, a unique battle mode, level ups and perks, and INFINITE MARES. I love them.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118609/5a940b366946612527e3f2215926550eb6df9305.png[/img]

[h3]More to come! Thank you for your continued interest and support! Pretty soon our goal of world peace through mare conquest will be fully realized.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118609/2f5932d17bf66eca0fa1e3f45230b145da885af7.png[/img]

If you've read this far you are a wonderful individual and are loved. Now you are required by mare law to put a smile on your face or the pasta police will confiscate your spaghetties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118609/f3e25a6aad2f9afc6100ef08718673523988b450.png[/img]

[h1]Have a cute mare song ^:) [/h1]

[previewyoutube=ymkbOKwHJi4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: MareQuest: An Interactive Tail
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ygseMj-PV28;full][/previewyoutube]

The most frequent question I get with MQ is regarding steam community items. That is trading cards, backgrounds, profile achievements, ect. As Marequest is a free game, it cannot qualify for these features. But the community has expressed interest and I'd love to deliver.

MareQuest: An Interactive Tail is my solution, an adorable procedural RPG visual novel set in the MareQuest multiverse. Follow a mystery mare with amnesia who goes on an adventure with new friends to retrieve her memories & explain strange happenings going on in the world.

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/3jgic8.png[/img]

To accomplish this project I've teamed up with a good friend Quote UnQuote to create beautiful art for this adventure. Both Quote and myself are very driven to completing this game and my conservative estimate of release is tentatively sometime this summer. 

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/4nc1lq.png[/img]

Sadly, to qualify for community items the game can't be free on Steam. I'm planning $5. This really kills me as MQ is a hobby and I don't ever want to see it as a job. My motivator is to connect as many folks as I can to my creation not hide it behind a paywall.

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/20c65o.png[/img]

I'll iterate #Marequest will remain FREE. Only MareQuest: An Interactive Tail will be $5. Steam is mysterious about other criteria to enable community items, they're not auto-enabled for being paid, but once enabled I do plan to also provide free links to the new game. 

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/2y3btg.png[/img]

I also want to mention Marequest will still be developed, but it'll be a some time before a new update while I work on MareQuest: An Interactive Tail. It is so exciting to work on something new from scratch and so much progress has been made only a month into development.

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/b1m0hm.png[/img]

Thank you everyone for the support! Cute mares deserve your love of course, but I am continually humbled by the amount of folks who enjoy my game. Feel free to join the goofy discord channel if you're interested in amre chat https://discord.gg/ExC33uCH

notes.title: 1 Full Week of Mares
notes.content:
Thanks mare enthusiasts for the warm welcome of MareQuest to steam! Over the course of the past week all of you have helped identify quite alot of bugs which I tried to resolve as quickly as possible. Fortunately, the last few days have been more stable and now it's time to break things again!

With this most recent update I have revamped a few features to (hopefully) be more stable, fix some bugs, and most importantly. Add BOOPS!!!

Pressing shift while standing will now allow you to boop! There will now spawn scunch-faced mares in the world for you to boop and befriend! Enjoy!

As always, please let me know if there are any issues. Preferably in the #bug-report channel of the discord: https://discord.com/invite/hueYuTRf6z

I will also be posting the OST on YouTube tonight! So stay tuned for that if you're archaic and listen to music on YouTube like I do! https://www.youtube.com/channel/UClQNUvucQtCeWU1BurvxJIA

Changelog:

	-Crystal will spawn in cave, interacting will get rid of the darkness
		(Crystal alicorns auto enabled)
	-Caves contain sad mares that can be lead to the exit for friendship
	-Caves blocked when leaving
>Added 'Mare Gaming' Minigame
	-Spawns hut in desert

	-Procedural text based prompt RPG with friendship rewards
	-Upon defeating 5 enemies final boss unlocked
>Added 20 steam achievements
>Added fullscreen button (Does not work with HTML5 build)
	-Window also resizeable though recommended to play default 960x540 resolution
>Added WASD support 
	-when selected W and S for up/down changed to E and Q respectively 
	-Mousewheel added for both Arrow Keys and WASD for up/down
>Poni Poni Dance Club opens only at night
>Revamped Main Menu
	-Added logo
	-Added media links
	-Added fullscreen button
	-Added control scheme button
	-Redid mare customization buttons

	-Displays current hat worn and hat ability
	-Displays friends needed for level up

	-Added fullscreen button
	-Added control scheme button

>Expanded mare procedural dialogue
>Items on the moon now float around

	-If player is flying will fly slightly faster than player

>Friends created through Friendship alicorn perk can be double friended
